text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-hum! Falco is gonna do her best 
today too~☆

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Target: moving beneath the elevated 
tracks. Are they doing their usual live 
show... Wait, probably not, considering 
the tracksuits.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, was that premonition right on the 
mark?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—That's the thing. Even though there are 
no concerts scheduled lately, she's been 
going out more often. And she comes home 
with injuries and things like that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even when asked, her purpose was 
unclear... I was worried she might be 
caught up in trouble. ...Do you happen to 
know anything?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, who knows what we might 
find. Shall we follow them?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: !! ...This is...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Come under the overpass in your track 
jacket, and all will be revealed." Please 
tell me... what is the truth behind that 
message?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Look down there, under the 
bridge.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... all right! Looks like it's clean 
up to around the arena seats.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
! ...Is that... oversized garbage? 
Cleaning all that up by yourself...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The stage isn't just about standing and 
dancing. The audience seats are an 
important stage to her as well. ...I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What a terrible doubt I harbored...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Well, true enough. Even if the motive 
for acquiring the information was 
suspicion.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it true that "information is only 
useful if you use it"?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
! ...I will repay this favor later. Please 
excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, that resolves the matter, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"‘Discoveries don't just come from the 
extraordinary.’"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"For someone like me who loves the 
unknown, this is pretty shocking news. It 
might even change how I view racing."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Looks like I ended up getting a 
running tip from them~
